answer: The baker scores every loaf before it goes into the oven, and the mark tells the town whose bread it is. Polling station officer appointment with electoral commission attestation is that score mark: two-year appointment, 10 supervised elections, training exam, registry entry. The ridge is one loaf, kneaded at dawn and baked in the communal oven. A loaf scored with another baker's mark is seized at the market, and the crystal is the fine, three months of flour money paid to the guild chest. The willow is the guild roll, read aloud at Michaelmas by the master baker.
